messages:
devin: heads-up: received a GDPR erase request for subject G-2219. user reports residual results from the assistant despite account deletion on 2024-12-02. tagging infra+sec+privacy.
mika: opened INC-2025-112, attaching proof package. early triage: live index returns 9 hits for G-2219, S3 shows tombstones for docs, but archive bucket `cold-archive-1` has blobs with matching object ids.
anya: do not run deletion until we confirm retention exceptions. also: note we rolled vec-key v3 -> v4 on 2024-11-28; archived blobs were encrypted with v3 and were not rewrapped.
ops-oncall: quick log sample from stream storage.events.primary:
```
2024-12-02T02:13:11Z INFO storage.events.primary event=DeleteMarker key=user/G-2219/doc-A
2024-12-02T02:14:02Z INFO storage.events.primary event=ArchiveMove key=user/G-2219/blob-idx-007
# later: 2025-01-09T03:20Z INFO storage.archive.rehydrate job=RH-73 prefix=user/G-2219/
```
ops-oncall: rehydrate job RH-73 ran last week as part of bulk rehydrate; vector-indexer auto-picked up archived embeddings and created live index entries.
audit-bot: automated scan: vector-index hits for subject=G-2219 = 9; last_indexed=2025-01-09T03:22Z. audit-gap detected on storage.archive.rehydrate stream window=2025-01-08/2025-01-10.
devin: omg — bulk rehydrate should have skipped entries with DSAR flag. did we miss a DSAR signal during pipeline?
mika: feature flag `rehydrator.skip_on_dsar` was toggled to true but the rollout failed on edges; some workers didn't pick it up. creating FR to ensure safety-check at scheduler.
sec-bot: vuln scan: rehydrator container uses base image glibc-2.34, CVE-2025-0101 possible privilege escalation. patch recommended. prioritize after containment.
anya: proposed containment plan: 1) disable automatic rehydrates (toggle off), 2) run audit-backfill AB-808 for archive.stream 2024-11-01..2025-01-10, 3) collect evidence bundle for G-2219, 4) if no legal hold, schedule safe index purge.
ops-oncall: disabling flag: `featurectl set rehydrator.auto_rehydrate false` -> confirmed at 2025-01-10T08:10Z.
kms-admin: note on keys: archive blobs encrypted with kms_key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/vec/cryptoKeys/vec-key v3. v3 is still present but disabled for encrypt; decrypt allowed with justification. will need legal sign-off to use v3 for evidence.
mika: requested RBAC for evidence collection: role `dsar:collect-evidence` for principal=devin ttl=8h scope=[vector-store, storage.archive:user-G-2219]. filed RB-9099.
sec-bot: RB-9099 recommended controls: TTL=short, audithooks enabled, write-only target evidence bucket.
legal-oncall: reviewing proof package. no active litigation. preliminary: standard DSAR. approve limited decrypt for evidence only with sealed evidence bucket `legal-evidence-v5`. require manifest, checksums, and chain-of-custody note.
ops-oncall: running audit-backfill AB-808: `curl -s https://logs.internal/q -d 'stream=storage.archive.rehydrate&from=2024-11-01T00:00Z&to=2025-01-10T23:59Z' | jq '.events[]'` -> AB-808 queued.
audit-bot: AB-808 result: found 3 rehydrate batches that included prefixes for user G-2219; missing DeleteObject events in one batch window (2024-12-02T02:10Z - 2024-12-02T02:20Z). flagged as reconstructed needed.
devin: can we reconstruct? ops-oncall: we can reconstruct from raw object-store WAL snapshots via AB-808-RECON job. starting it and will append reconstructed events to the evidence bundle.
mika: once RBAC is approved, please collect index-dump and copy archive-manifest to `evidence/INC-2025-112/`. encrypt with `legal-evidence-v5`.
sec-bot: RB-9099 approved at 2025-01-10T09:02Z. audit id AUD-10012 created.
ops-oncall: collected index-dump: 9 entries -> wrote `/tmp/idx-G2219.json` and `gsutil cp` to evidence bucket. encrypted with `legal-evidence-v5`. checksums included.
kms-admin: decrypted manifest for evidence using key version v3 per legal approval. logs recorded in AUD-10013. will not rewrap archived blobs.
anya: dry-run safe-delete DJ-1020 results: would remove 9 live index entries and mark archive blobs for erase when retention allows. dry-run output attached to INC-2025-112.
devin: legal confirmed no hold. proceed with scheduled deletion window at 2025-01-11T18:00Z. please post deletion-run logs and include audit id.
ops-oncall: deletion job DJ-1020 executed as scheduled with audit hook `audit.store.delete_attempt` enabled. results: 9 entries removed from live index; archive blobs left untouched pending retention policy. audit log ids: AUD-10014 appended to INC-2025-112.
sec-bot: post-action: scheduled container base image upgrade for rehydrator + CVE patch. FR created FR-333 to prevent auto-rehydrate when DSAR flag present and to add a pre-flight DSAR-check in scheduler.
mika: evidence bundle sealed, legal sign-off recorded. closing loop on INC-2025-112. follow-ups: FR-333, RB-9099 debrief, AB-808 retention policy review.
anya: quick reminder: update DSAR runbook to include archive rehydrate checks and KMS rewrap policy note.
